tasks.short: Prepare reports of manufacturing performance and its trends.

steps.what: Prepare reports of manufacturing performance from totals
Draft the performance narrative from those totals

loop.purpose: Draft the report prose from traced totals
loop.input: performance total rows and the report headings
loop.check: every number matches a total row
loop.stop: one draft, or stop when a number has no row
loop.why_not_simpler: the period story changes, so a fixed sentence cannot carry it

steps.what: Review trends in the manufacturing performance report

outputs: filed copy of signed performance report v1

tasks.design: A dashboard on {BI} prepares the performance tables from recorded totals. A bounded draft in {DOCS} may write prose only from those totals. The engineer reviews the trends, signs the report, and a job publishes that version. The draft is not the record.
tasks.previous_blocker: The report was reassembled each period, and a sentence could carry a number nobody could trace.
tasks.enabler_now: The totals already exist and can feed a dashboard without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: A trend still needs a person who knows what changed on the line.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides what the trend means and whether the report is fit to send.

ambition.what: Refresh the performance tables each time the period totals close.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the report cycle on the trends and the signature.

reach.task: Read the signed report and ask for a change

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says an artefact generator fills templates from records, a model may draft prose, every number must trace to a record, and the engineer signs.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: Every number in the draft must match a total row or the draft is discarded.
Configure the existing totals before a new store.
unknowns: Which totals are the official ones.
research_questions: How often a total is restated after the report is signed.

already_counted.description: Reviewing the trends stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare documentation for new manufacturing processes and procedures.

steps.what: Prepare documentation for new manufacturing processes
Fill engineering procedure fields from recorded parameters
Draft procedure sentences from the traced parameters

loop.purpose: Draft procedure prose from traced parameters
loop.check: every value matches a parameter row
loop.stop: one draft, or stop when a value has no row
loop.why_not_simpler: the sentence shape changes with the process, so a fixed line does not fit

outputs: filed copy of signed engineering procedures v1

tasks.design: The engineer prepares the outline. A job fills procedure fields in {DOCS} from parameters in {OPS_SYSTEM}, and a bounded draft writes sentences only from those fields. The engineer signs the procedures, and a later job files that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedures were copied from the last product, and numbers drifted from the live parameters.
tasks.enabler_now: Parameters for the new process can be listed and checked.
tasks.still_hard: The first run of a new process is not in the old record.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides that the procedure is fit to release.
tasks.altitude: The engineer still writes the intent of the new process. Field filling and filing shrink.

reach.learn: Which parameter version the document froze

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says an artefact generator fills templates from records, a model may draft prose, every number must trace to a record, and the engineer signs.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: A value with no parameter row is removed before signature.
Configure the parameter record before a new store.
unknowns: Who else must sign a new procedure.
research_questions: How the firm versions a procedure once it is filed.

already_counted.description: Preparing the outline stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.short: Design equipment and workspace layouts for efficiency.

steps.what: Design the layout of equipment and workspaces
Measure travel distances from the layout coordinates
Judge whether the layout improves efficiency

outputs: filed copy of signed equipment layout v1

tasks.design: The engineer designs the layout of equipment and workspaces. A job measures travel from the coordinates the engineer entered in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer judges efficiency, signs the layout in {DOCS}, and a job files that version. A model does not move a safety zone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Travel was estimated by eye, and the sketch and the numbers lived apart.
tasks.enabler_now: Coordinates can be entered once and measured by a fixed rule.
tasks.still_hard: A short path can still be unsafe or impossible to staff.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides the layout and any safety zone.
tasks.altitude: The engineer still spends the week on the floor design. Measuring travel shrinks.

reach.task: Mark the signed layout on the floor

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.
Digest [S14] says the Machinery Regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027, so this design does not let a model change a machine safety function.

assumptions: The engineer enters the coordinates. The job does not invent them.
Configure the sheet before a new tool.
unknowns: Whether a safety zone is fixed by a standard.
Who else must sign a layout that moves a machine.
research_questions: How often the real floor differs from the drawing.

already_counted.description: Designing the layout stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate capabilities and production schedules to the line.

steps.what: Communicate manufacturing capabilities and production schedules
Check schedule totals against the order record
Sign the production schedules to facilitate processes

outputs: filed copy of signed production schedule v1

tasks.design: The engineer drafts the capabilities and the production schedules. A job checks totals against {ERP}. The engineer signs that version in {EMAIL}, and only then does a job send it. An unsigned schedule is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Schedules went out from a mailbox while the order record had already changed.
tasks.enabler_now: Order totals can be checked before the send.
tasks.still_hard: A late order change can void the version that was signed.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides what the line is told, and when.

ambition.what: Send a schedule the same day the order board changes, only after signing that version.

tasks.altitude: The engineer still owns the message. Checking totals and the send shrink.

reach.task: Run the line to the signed schedule

evidence.claim: Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.
The engineering digest says an artefact generator fills templates from records, a model may draft prose, every number must trace to a record, and the engineer signs.

assumptions: The send uses the signed version and stops if the order total has changed.
Configure the order record before a new store.
unknowns: How long a signed version stays valid.
research_questions: How often orders change between signature and send.

already_counted.description: Drafting the schedule stays inside the remaining time of that step.

role.altitude: The manufacturing engineer spends the week on cause, design, and the signed decision. Collecting rows and filing a signed note move to a job.
reach: Quality technicians get a field list for the part they collect, instead of a blank request.
Planners wait for the signed note before they move a routing.
skills_to_grow: Reject a figure that has no source row.
Release only the version they signed, and leave a safety function to a person.
role.ambitious_version: A signed change note can open a controlled routing update, and the engineer still releases it.
